description: This file defines a TaskService class that implements task management operations such as create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) for tasks within a task management API. It interacts with the task repository and handles business logic related to tasks.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Provides CRUD operations for tasks, implementing ITaskService interface.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks as a list of TaskDto objects asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new task based on the provided TaskCreateDto and returns the created task as TaskDto.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by id with new data from TaskUpdateDto; returns the updated task as TaskDto.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task by its id; returns true if successful, false otherwise.
